subject: URGENT: APAC production latency & error surge — routing decision required
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@harborcloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 02:15:00 +0000
Subject: High 5xx + latency impacting APAC customers (urgent)

Kim —

We started seeing a sharp increase in error rates around 01:40 UTC from APAC nodes. Our customers in SG and AU have request success dropping to ~72% and median latency jumped from 120ms to 1.8s. Throughput also fell by ~40% as retries pile up. This is impacting 3 paying customers in our top-10 list (HarborDrive, ShippingHQ, and CloudPayments).

Attached is a short export of traces and the sample logs from our agents (harbor_incident_log_0629.json). Can Redwood confirm whether this is a regional hardware issue, routing change, or something on the model-serving path? We need an ETA and immediate mitigation — customers are asking for an RTO.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Ops, HarborCloud

Attachments: harbor_incident_log_0629.json
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@harborcloud.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 03:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: High 5xx + latency impacting APAC customers (urgent)

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the data and sorry for the disruption. I've looped in our on-call infra lead and regional ops. Initial look suggests an AZ-level request amplification in APAC-west (az-ap-2) combined with an unexpectedly high cache miss rate after a prior deployment. We're spinning up additional capacity in APAC and evaluating a cross-region steer to US-W2 as a temporary mitigation.

Can we schedule a short bridge at 03:30 UTC? If you can share any TTFB histograms by tenant that would help prioritize.

I'm on standby — will update within 30 minutes.

— Kim Park
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 03:20:00 +0000
Subject: ACTION: APAC routing decision (recommendation + risk)

Team —

Summary (so far): APAC-west az-ap-2 is showing a sustained spike in 5xx and latency starting 01:40 UTC. Customer traces show a mix of model runtime retransmits and K/V cache misses; token generation latency spikes. HarborCloud has provided logs (attached).

Recommendation: Execute a controlled cross-region steer to US-W2 for traffic originating from SG/AU tenants for the next 3 hours, with 10% incremental ramp every 3 minutes. Concurrently, warm model instances in US-W2 using a pre-warm prompt set and enable prefix cache priming for the highest-volume tenants.

Rollback: If error rate in US-W2 exceeds 3% or median p95 latency > 1.2s during ramp, immediately stop the ramp and divert to baseline region (APAC-east).

Risks & notes:
- Cold KV cache in US-W2 will temporarily increase per-request cost and p50 latency for prime tenants.
- Some geo-anchored compliance customers may see changed IP ranges — need legal/CS sign-off if persistent.
- We may need to issue credits if SLA impacted beyond 4 hours; prep finance/CS.

Please confirm readiness: Soojin (routing hooks + traffic steer), Vivek (capacity & infra), Laura (CS customer comms). I will take point with HarborCloud.

— Kim
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 03:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: ACTION: APAC routing decision (recommendation + risk)

Kim —

We can implement the 10% incremental ramp via the routing policy service. Technical checklist completed in 10 minutes: pre-warm job scheduled for US-W2 (models: redwood-open-7B-quant), KV cache priming command ready. Will run a simulated warmup to verify latency targets before first 10% cut. Also setting a short-circuit fallback to APAC-east if we detect token error amplification.

Estimated time to first 10% ramp: 18 minutes. I will post real-time telemetry to the bridge.

— Soojin
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 04:05:00 +0000
Subject: Exec visibility requested — HarborCloud APAC incident (customer escalation)

Hannah, Marcus —

FYI: HarborCloud reported a production-impacting event in APAC (az-ap-2) causing high 5xx and latency for key tenants. We are initiating a controlled cross-region steer to US-W2 with incremental ramp and cache priming. Soojin and Vivek are executing now; Laura is prepping comms and credit guidance. HarborCloud requested urgent ETA and will want a post-incident write-up.

Key asks:
- Approve emergency region steer (customer-facing change) — I will take full ownership and follow rollback rules.
- Be prepared for possible credit conversation if SLA breach >4h.

I will update once we hit 50% steer.

— Kim Park
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@harborcloud.com>
Cc: ops@harborcloud.com; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 19:05:00 +0000
Subject: Update: APAC mitigation & next steps

Priya —

Quick update from the bridge and apologies for the disruption earlier today. We implemented a controlled steer to US-W2 beginning at 03:40 UTC. Ramp reached 60% by 04:20 UTC after warming; error rates dropped from 28% to 2.4% and median latency returned to ~160ms for the affected tenants. We have kept a 40% footprint in APAC-east for routing affinity.

Next steps:
- We will continue to monitor for 6 hours, keep prefix caches primed, and prepare a full post-incident report with root cause analysis and mitigation timeline.
- Laura will coordinate customer-facing comms and propose a goodwill credit; we will share the draft with HarborCloud.
- Technical artifacts and logs are attached (psc_trace_apac_0629.png).

If you need an executive call, Hannah and Marcus are available to join — let me know a time.

Thanks for your patience.

— Kim Park
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: psc_trace_apac_0629.png
